# Recovered.org

> Comprehensive resource for understanding addiction, substance use disorders, and behavioral addictions with evidence-based treatment information and support guidance.

Recovered.org provides educational content on addiction causes, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment options. The site covers substance abuse (heroin, opioids, cocaine), behavioral addictions (gambling, food, internet), withdrawal management, and practical support strategies for individuals and families affected by addiction.

## Key Topics

- Substance Use Disorders
- DSM-5 Diagnostic Criteria
- Addiction Treatment
- Withdrawal Symptoms
- Behavioral Addiction
- Heroin and Opioids
- Cocaine
- Brain Chemistry
- Addiction Recovery
- Intervention Strategies
- Overdose Statistics
- Controlled Substances Act
- Mental Health
- Addiction Genetics
- Drug Paraphernalia

## Understanding Addiction Fundamentals

- [What is Addiction? Signs, symptoms, diagnosing and treatment](https://recovered.org/addiction): Comprehensive overview of addiction definition, symptoms, and treatment options.
- [Addiction vs Dependence](https://recovered.org/addiction/addiction-vs-dependence): Educational comparison of addiction and dependence using DSM-5 criteria.
- [The Biology of Addiction and the Brain](https://recovered.org/addiction/addiction-and-the-brain): Educational content on how drugs affect brain chemistry and neurotransmitters.
- [Addiction and Genetics: Is addiction hereditary?](https://recovered.org/addiction/addiction-and-genetics): Guide exploring genetic predisposition and hereditary factors in addiction.

## Recognizing Addiction

- [Warning Signs of Addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/warning-signs-of-addiction): Guide to recognizing physical and psychological symptoms of addiction.
- [How to Recognize Drug Paraphernalia](https://recovered.org/addiction/drug-paraphernalia): Educational guide on identifying drug paraphernalia and recognizing substance use.
- [Diagnosing Addiction (Substance Use Disorders)](https://recovered.org/addiction/diagnosing-addiction): Guide to addiction diagnosis using DSM-5 diagnostic assessment criteria.
- [The 10 Most Common Addictions in The USA](https://recovered.org/addiction/what-are-the-top-10-most-common-addictions): Overview of top 10 most abused substances and addiction statistics in USA.

## Treatment and Recovery

- [Getting Help With Addiction: Seeking treatment and support](https://recovered.org/addiction/get-help-with-addiction): Guide to addiction treatment options and support resources with expert advice.
- [Withdrawal Symptoms: causes, timeline, and treatment options](https://recovered.org/addiction/withdrawal-symptoms): Guide to withdrawal symptoms, timeline, and medical treatment options.
- [How to Help Family or Friends Struggling With Addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/helping-a-family-member-or-friend): Tips and intervention strategies for supporting loved ones with addiction issues.

## Substance-Specific Information

- [Deadliest illicit and prescription drugs](https://recovered.org/addiction/dangerous-drugs): Overview of dangerous and deadliest drugs with overdose statistics.
- [Polysubstance Use: Effects, Risks & Warning Signs](https://recovered.org/addiction/polysubstance-abuse): Educational guide on polysubstance use risks, effects, and warning signs.
- [The Cost of Drugs: How it Affects Addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/the-cost-of-drugs-how-it-affects-addiction): Analysis of drug costs, overdose statistics, and economic impact of addiction.

## Behavioral Addictions

- [What are Behavioral Addictions and How are They Treated?](https://recovered.org/addiction/behaviors): Overview of behavioral addictions including gambling, sex, and internet addiction.
- [Gambling Addiction - Signs, symptoms, risks and treatment](https://recovered.org/addiction/behaviors/gambling-addiction): Guide to gambling addiction recognized by APA with treatment resources.
- [Internet Addiction - Symptoms, signs, and treatment](https://recovered.org/addiction/behaviors/internet-addiction): Guide to internet addiction symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment strategies.
- [Understanding and Overcoming Food Addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/behaviors/food-addiction): Expert insights on recognizing and overcoming food addiction.

## Resources and Support

- [Commonly asked questions about drug & alcohol addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/addiction-faqs): FAQ addressing common questions about drug, alcohol, and behavioral addictions.
